_comment: The corpus for round 0. Its Merkle root becomes a consensus value, so every
field here is part of what the network agrees on.
REVISIONS ARE COMMIT SHAs, NOT BRANCH NAMES. A HuggingFace dataset is a
moving target: files are re-uploaded, corrected and added. Pinned to `main`,
someone rebuilding this corpus next year would get different bytes, fail to
reproduce the root, and be unable to verify a single chunk against it.
Only 2024-2025 dumps of FineWeb-Edu are taken. The full dataset spans 2013
onward, and averaging over a decade would set the model's knowledge cutoff a
decade back. Per-dump configs make choosing recency possible; Stack v3 has no
such split and is taken as shards, which is a random sample of repositories.
Both sources are redistributable: ODC-By requires attribution and permits
redistribution, which a protocol where seed nodes serve corpus chunks to
strangers structurally requires. Nemotron-CC is higher quality and fresher on
the web side and cannot be used at all: its licence forbids redistributing any

sources._comment: Educational-quality web text, filtered from FineWeb by a classifier trained on Llama-3-70B annotations. Newest crawl here is CC-MAIN-2025-26, June 2025 — the freshest redistributable web data at this scale that exists.

Source code, GitHub as of 7 August 2025. Rows are whole repositories with their files in an array, so each file becomes a document and repository grouping is preserved. Taken as shards rather than filtered by language: weighting the corpus toward this project's own language would be a bias frozen into consensus for the whole round.
